issue.title: Require filled PR template in delivery rules
issue.body:
## Summary

Agents have been opening PRs with thin ad-hoc bodies (`Details` + a short checklist) instead of filling [`.cursor/templates/pr-template.md`](.cursor/templates/pr-template.md). The template and `/create-pr` already exist; `delivery.mdc` only required title + `Closes #NNN`, so thin bodies still “complied.”

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `delivery.mdc` (alwaysApply) requires every agent-opened PR body to be filled from `.cursor/templates/pr-template.md` (TLDR, Reviewer checklist, Details with `Closes #NNN`, type, Technical changes, Testing, How to verify, Follow-ups)
- [ ] Clarify that this applies whenever a PR is created — not only when the user types `/create-pr`
- [ ] Point other always-on pointers (`agent-guardrails`, `commands.mdc` / issue-tracking if needed) at the same requirement so agents do not fall back to generic Summary/Test plan shapes
- [ ] No product/runtime code changes

## Verification

- [ ] Read `delivery.mdc` — mandatory template section present
- [ ] Docs/rules only; CI gates still pass if anything under `src/` is untouched
